answer: Filling 20 aliases therefore needs 20 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. Because the rationale is hashed into the timber record and indexed in the plume history, the nebula audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 3 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
